title: Numerical and Algebraic Expressions
preview: Powers and exponents, order of operations, writing and evaluating algebraic expressions, factoring, distributive property, and equivalent expressions.
description: Indiana standards 6.NS.5–8 and 6.AF.1. Students translate between numerical and algebraic representations and use properties of operations to rewrite expressions.

sections.label: 5-1 Powers and Exponents
sections.description: Evaluate positive rational numbers raised to whole-number exponents.

sections.label: 5-2 Numerical Expressions
sections.description: Apply the order of operations and properties of operations to evaluate numerical expressions with nonnegative rationals.

sections.label: 5-3 Write Algebraic Expressions
sections.description: Use variables to write expressions for real-world and mathematical problems.

sections.label: 5-4 Evaluate Algebraic Expressions
sections.description: Substitute values for variables and evaluate the resulting expression.

sections.label: 5-5 Factors and Multiples
sections.description: Find the greatest common factor of two whole numbers ≤100 and the least common multiple of two whole numbers ≤12.

sections.label: 5-6 Use the Distributive Property
sections.description: Apply the distributive property to rewrite numerical and algebraic expressions.

sections.label: 5-7 Equivalent Algebraic Expressions
sections.description: Apply properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions; justify equivalence.
